title: RBI Amends Payments Bank Deposit Interest Rate Disclosure Rules from October 1, 2026
description: RBI's Payments Banks Amendment Directions, 2026 require deposit interest rates to strictly follow the schedule disclosed in advance on the bank's website from 1 October 2026.The post RBI Amends Payments Bank Deposit Interest Rate Disclosure Rules from October 1, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
